notes:
Summary and background:
- Company: Orbitline Technologies — multi-tenant conversational agent product for SMB and mid-market customers (chat + app actions).
- GTM: sells to product teams; charges per-seat + usage-based API for heavy automation customers.
- Current stage: started with Hosted API evaluation; want clear upgrade path to Dedicated when 95th-percentile qps/concurrency grows.

Recent activity (bullets / shorthand):
- 2026-02-18: Intro call (Maya) — high-level product fit, gave quickstart + sample requests. Wants streaming + tool-calling for agent orchestration.
- 2026-02-25: Fireflies call (ff_9f7a2c0d) — demoed hosted streaming; they ran 2-hour soak with small tenant set. Observed intermittent chunk drops at ~200 concurrent ws connections.
- 2026-03-01: Demo (ff_2b4e1a7c) — SE (Elliot) showed function-calling reliability and fallback to non-streaming; customer asked about automatic fallback policies.
- 2026-03-04: Sent hosted pricing + estimated ARR slide deck (drive link). Awaiting internal budgeting.

Requirements & priorities (customer-stated):
- Latency SLOs: first-streamed-token <300ms for interactive agents; end-to-end response with tool calls <900ms (target).
- Streaming stability is top priority — need stable websocket or server-sent events for 100–500 concurrent streaming connections per tenant.
- Per-tenant quotas: per-tenant rate limits, burst windows, quota carryover and overridable burst allowances for higher-tier tenants. Need per-api-key metering and per-route quotas.
- Tool calling: reliable function-calling and deterministic retries; clear semantics for idempotency and long-running tool responses.
- Metrics & observability: token-level cost breakdown per tenant, per-route latency histograms, streaming error traces.
- Data controls: option to restrict EU customers to EU region (data residency), retention controls and audit logs. SSO/SAML mandatory for admin UI.

POC notes / results so far:
- POC conducted on Hosted API for rapid time-to-value. Used streaming + function calls with a small tenant replication sim (10 tenants).
- Observed: median first-byte latency ~120–180ms, 95th ~420ms under steady-state. Under burst test (200 concurrent streams) saw ~12% of streams drop or experience chunking issues — customer flagged streaming reliability.
- Function-calling worked for single-step actions; multi-step orchestration sometimes hit rate limits quickly with default quota settings.

Customer quotes & paraphrases:
- "We need streaming that doesn't drop mid-session — customers notice and churn."
- "Hosted is great to start; we need predictable unit costs and a migration plan to reserved capacity as we scale."

Next-step & commercial asks:
- Orbitline requests: Dedicated POC scoped to 500 concurrent streaming connections, per-tenant rate limiting demo, and a pricing band for committed capacity (monthly).
- Legal wants a copy of Redwood DPA + SOC2/ISO artifacts; security has follow-ups around KMS integration.

Blockers (short):
- Legal/DPA approval; Budget hold while VP Product confirms ARR; technical proof that streaming at 500 concurrent per-tenant is stable.

Action items (owner):

- Elliot (SE): prepare synthetic traffic profile (qps, concurrency, typical token length) and run internal stability test; demo per-tenant quota config.
- Product: share migration playbook (hosted -> dedicated) and per-tenant billing options doc.
